name: nocodb
description: NocoDB (Postgres): DB auto-detection dumps the Postgres DB (all bases/tables/views live there). The nc_data volume carries config incl. the auto-generated JWT secret (logins/API tokens) and is tarred as a named volume - keep it, or all tokens are invalidated on restore. If NC_ connects to an EXTERNAL DB (NC_DB), that DB is outside this stack and needs its own backup.
